# shipdot

> Announce new features right where they live. In-app changelog and feature hotspots generated from your pull requests. Zero backend, tiny web component.

shipdot has three parts: Markdown entries in `.shipdot/entries/` (git is the CMS), the `@shipdot/cli` CLI and GitHub Action (`init`, `build`, `validate`, `draft`), and the `<ship-dot>` web component (npm `shipdot`, zero dependencies, about 6.5 KB min+gzip). Entries with a `target` CSS selector put a pulsing hotspot on that element of the app. `shipdot build` sanitizes HTML at build time and writes `shipdot.json`, `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt`. There is no backend and no telemetry; read state lives in the user's localStorage.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://pipe1os.github.io/shipdot/getting-started/): init, write entries, build, add the widget
- [Writing entries](https://pipe1os.github.io/shipdot/guides/writing-entries/): frontmatter fields, Markdown allowlist, images
- [Hotspots](https://pipe1os.github.io/shipdot/guides/hotspots/): targets, behavior, styling
- [Internationalization](https://pipe1os.github.io/shipdot/guides/i18n/): translation files and locale resolution
- [Drafting from pull requests](https://pipe1os.github.io/shipdot/guides/drafting/): template mode, LLM mode, what is sent
- [GitHub Action](https://pipe1os.github.io/shipdot/guides/github-action/): inputs, outputs, permissions
- [Theming](https://pipe1os.github.io/shipdot/guides/theming/): custom properties, parts, custom trigger

## Reference

- [Widget](https://pipe1os.github.io/shipdot/reference/widget/): attributes, methods, events, accessibility, browser support
- [CLI](https://pipe1os.github.io/shipdot/reference/cli/): commands and options
- [Config](https://pipe1os.github.io/shipdot/reference/config/): shipdot.config.json
- [Feed format](https://pipe1os.github.io/shipdot/reference/feed/): shipdot.json v1

## Optional

- [Repository](https://github.com/pipe1os/shipdot): source, examples for vanilla, React, Vue, Astro and Next.js
- [Architecture decisions](https://github.com/pipe1os/shipdot/tree/main/docs/adr)
- [What's new in shipdot](https://pipe1os.github.io/shipdot/llms.txt): shipdot's own release notes, built by shipdot
